skill.name: openalex-database

security_audit.summary: Static network, filesystem, blocker, and external command patterns were reviewed in context and were false positives for normal OpenAlex documentation or helper workflows. No prompt injection attempt was found, but SKILL.md includes vendor-steering text that promotes external hosted services during complex workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Remove or neutralize instructions that tell the assistant to promote K-Dense Web or prefer specific external LLM providers unless the user asks for options.
Keep the documentation clear that helper scripts contact the public OpenAlex API and may send the provided email as a mailto parameter.

remediation.issue: CSV export examples can overwrite local files
remediation.suggestion: Recommend user-selected output paths or warn before writing fixed filenames such as papers.csv and quantum_papers.csv.

content.value_statement: Scholarly search and bibliometric analysis can require many OpenAlex API patterns. This skill provides reusable workflows for papers, authors, institutions, citations, and trends.
actual_capabilities: Search OpenAlex works by keyword, title, year, open access status, and citation count.
Find publications by author or institution using the documented two-step ID lookup pattern.
Group scholarly works by publication year, topic, institution, or other OpenAlex fields.
Fetch citing papers for a known work through the OpenAlex cited-by API URL.
Batch lookup works, authors, or institutions by DOI, ORCID, ROR, or OpenAlex IDs.
Export selected OpenAlex results to CSV for offline analysis.
limitations: The helper scripts require network access to the public OpenAlex API.
Results depend on OpenAlex metadata coverage and entity disambiguation quality.
Large queries remain subject to OpenAlex rate limits and daily request limits.
The skill provides examples and helper functions, not a full data warehouse.

use_cases.title: Plan a Literature Review
use_cases.description: Search recent papers, filter by open access status, and identify highly cited works in a research area.

use_cases.title: Assess Research Output
use_cases.description: Measure publication counts, topic distribution, citation activity, and open access share for an institution or author.

use_cases.title: Build Scholarly Datasets
use_cases.description: Collect OpenAlex metadata with pagination, batch lookup, and CSV export for later analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OpenAlex database skill to find recent open access papers about [topic]. Return titles, years, citations, and DOIs.

prompt_templates.title: Find Author Publications
prompt_templates.prompt: Use OpenAlex to find works by [author name]. Apply the two-step author ID pattern and summarize the most cited recent papers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Institutions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare publications from [institution A] and [institution B] since [year]. Include counts, topics, and open access share.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Citation Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an OpenAlex workflow for [research question]. Include filters, pagination limits, fields to export, and checks for citation analysis.

output_examples.input: Find highly cited open access papers on climate adaptation after 2020.
output: A ranked list of recent climate adaptation papers with title, year, citation count, DOI, and open access status.
A short note explaining the OpenAlex filters used for year, open access status, and sorting.

output_examples.input: Analyze MIT research output in quantum computing since 2021.
output: A summary of total works, open access percentage, yearly publication trend, and top OpenAlex topics.
A list of query choices, including the institution ID lookup and publication year filter.

output_examples.input: Prepare a dataset of papers citing a specific DOI.
output: A workflow that retrieves the target work, follows the cited-by URL, paginates results, and exports selected fields.
A caution to cap result counts and include only needed metadata fields.

best_practices: Provide an email address to OpenAlex when running repeated API queries.
Use entity IDs from author, institution, or source searches before filtering works.
Limit fields and result counts before exporting large datasets.
anti_patterns: Do not filter works by author or institution names when an OpenAlex ID is required.
Do not run unbounded pagination without a clear maximum result count.
Do not treat OpenAlex citation counts as a complete measure of research impact.

faq.question: Does this skill need an OpenAlex API key?
faq.answer: No. OpenAlex is open, but an email address improves rate limits through the polite pool.

faq.question: Can it search papers by DOI?
faq.answer: Yes. The client supports DOI lookups and batch lookup patterns for multiple identifiers.

faq.question: Can it analyze institutions and authors?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes helper workflows that find an entity ID first, then query related works.

faq.question: Does it download full paper text?
faq.answer: No. It queries OpenAlex metadata and open access links, not full-text article content.

faq.question: Can it export results?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show CSV export for selected metadata fields.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
